comment: Package kit hints for the CRM (docs/package-testing.md «Module kit file»). The CRM links to Counterparties and Chat (built in) and is linked from two packages: Masterplan (units of a deal, the deal's history) and Contracts (the deal picker, a contract's deal). Both are installed as linked packages; on the upgrade source (main) Masterplan is already a package and Contracts is built in. The seed makes a company and a deal through the APIs so the Counterparties timeline has a deal line (the CRM's own demo writes rows directly, without the timeline). Visibility is set to «own» so the plain user's lists are filtered.

apiParams.id: SELECT id FROM crm_deals WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.stageId: SELECT id FROM crm_stages ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.dealId: SELECT deal_id FROM mp_units WHERE deal_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY node_id LIMIT 1
apiParams.companyId: SELECT entity_id FROM cmp_events WHERE kind = 'deal' AND entity_type = 'company' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
apiParams.contractId: SELECT id FROM ctr_contracts WHERE deal_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

pageParams.param: SELECT id::text FROM crm_deals WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

links.name: Masterplan → units of a CRM deal
Contracts → the deal picker
links.absentWhy: the CRM removed (fresh): Contracts answers an empty picker; on the upgrade window Contracts (built in on main) is absent too: 404

links.name: Counterparties → deal lines of the company timeline
Masterplan registry without the CRM's data (deal titles from crm_deals while it exists)

openToUsersWhy: The CRM is open to everyone signed in (it has no «use» permission: crm.admin and crm.all only widen it); deals are filtered by the visibility setting («own» in the kit: deals a person owns, watches or created).
openToUsersWhy.meta: settings, stock lists, the person's own rights
openToUsersWhy.users: people picker (names and avatars of active users, as elsewhere in the portal)
openToUsersWhy.clients: client picker of Counterparties (its own visibility applies)
openToUsersWhy.counters: chip counters of the person's visible deals (numbers, no deals)
openToUsersWhy.board: the columns of the pipeline (stages); the deals inside are the person's visible ones
openToUsersWhy.activity-board: the columns of the activities board (time buckets); the activities inside are of visible deals
openToUsersWhy.pipelines: pipelines and stages (structure, shared by everyone using the CRM)
